 This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India Praying To Issue
A Writ In The Nature Of The Mandamus, Thereby
Directing The Respondent Nos.1 To 4 Authorities To
Consider The Representations By The Petitioner Vide
Annexure-F Dated 19.07.2022 And To Award
Compensation To The Entire Extent Of The Land
Including The Kharab Land Of The Petition Land And
To Pay The Compensation Amount With All Statutory
Benefits As Per Prevailing Market Value In Terms Of
The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In
Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement
Act, 2013 And Etc.
 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary
Hearing, This Day, Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice Suraj Govindaraj
 Oral Order
(Per: Hon'Ble Mr Justice Suraj Govindaraj)
1.

Sri.Shivakumar R.Tengli, learned Additional Government Advocate accepts notice for the
respondents.

2.  The petitioner is before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
i. Issue a writ in the nature of the mandamus, thereby directing the respondent Nos.1 to 4 authorities to consider the representations by the petitioner vide Annexure-F dated 19.07.2022 and to award compensation to NC: 2024:KHC-K:6891 the entire extent of the land including the kharab land of the petition land and to pay the compensation amount with all statutory benefits as per prevailing market value in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Dharmavathi Bhutada vs The State Of Karnatka And Ors on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25058905/
2 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
ii. Pass any such other order, as this Hon'ble Court deemed fit and proper, under the facts and circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice and equity."
3. Petitioner claims to be the owner of the land in Sy.No.129 measuring 18 acres 10 guntas situated Pothagal village at ward No.33 Raichur.

entities.text: Dharmavathi Bhutada vs The State Of Karnatka And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A preliminary notification having been issued under subsection (1) of Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, hereinafter referred to as 'the Act, 2013'), the final notification under subsection (1) of section 19 of the Act also came to be issued acquiring an extent of 03 acres 24 guntas.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: An award having been passed on 14.02.2022, awarding compensation only to an extent of 7 guntas and denying compensation to an NC: 2024:KHC-K:6891 extent of 3 acres 17 guntas on the ground that the same is a kharab land, the petitioner having received the award notice, did not accept the same and submitted a representation on 19.07.2022 requesting the respondent No.4-SLAO to pass award in respect of 3 acres 17 guntas of Pothgal village, taluk and district Raichur, which has been designated as pot kharab-A land, no action having been taken, the petitioner is before this court seeking for the aforesaid relief.

4. The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the case of Shivappa S/o Prabhappa Mugalolli vs. The General Manager, Upper Krishna Project and Others in W.P.No.106515/2015 and connected matters by its order dated 07.03.2023 has held that even the kharab land forms part of the ownership of the land which is acquired, which would imply that if a land is acquired even as regards kharab land, compensation is required to be paid to.

entities.text: Shivappa S/o Prabhappa Mugalolli vs. The General Manager, Upper Krishna Project and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
ORDER 6. Writ petitions allowed.
7.

A mandamus is issued directing respondent No.4 to consider the representation of the petitioner at Annexure-F dated 19.07.2022 and award compensation towards the pot kharab-A land also in terms of decision of this Court in the case of Shivappa S/o Prabhappa Mugalolli vs. The General Manager, Upper Krishna Project and Others in W.P.No.106515/2015 and
